questions.text: It is 2026-11-09 and this lost 1R: Brent went through 98.0 first, as random entries with this stop did 38.3% of the time. What happened? Name at least one reason that is a thesis error, not luck.
The source of this idea is consensus (Zweig: beware the crowd), yet managed money is only at the 17.0th percentile on your side: what is your own edge here beyond what the consensus already says?
